Full API spec:
openapi: 3.0.0
info:
  title: Pocket Expense API
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /api/pocket-expenses:
    get:
      summary: List pocket expenses
      parameters:
        - name: user_id
          in: query
          schema:
            type: integer
        - name: client_id
          in: query
          required: true
          schema:
            type: integer
      responses:
        200:
          description: Paginated list of pocket expenses
    post:
      summary: Create pocket expense
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [date, merchant_name, amount, currency, expense_type_id]
      responses:
        201:
          description: Created pocket expense
  /api/pocket-expenses/{id}:
    get:
      summary: Get single pocket expense
      responses:
        200:
          description: Pocket expense details
    put:
      summary: Update pocket expense
      responses:
        200:
          description: Updated pocket expense
    delete:
      summary: Delete pocket expense
      responses:
        204:
          description: Expense deleted
  /api/uploads/pocket-expense/csv:
    post:
      summary: Upload CSV file for batch expense creation
      requestBody:
        content:
          multipart/form-data:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [csv_file, user_id, client_id]
      responses:
        201:
          description: Upload initiated successfully
        422:
          description: Validation errors
  /api/uploads/{uploadId}/status:
    get:
      summary: Get upload processing status
      responses:
        200:
          description: Upload status and validation results
  /api/expense-sources:
    get:
      summary: List available expense sources for client
      parameters:
        - name: client_id
          in: query
          required: true
      responses:
        200:
          description: List of expense sources
Shared Knowledge: Follow Laravel conventions: migrations use timestamp prefixes, models use singular names, controllers use resource naming. All API responses must be wrapped in API Resources. Use DB transactions for multi-table operations. CSV validation is synchronous all-or-nothing, background processing uses Laravel Queues. Policy authorization checks user_feature_permission table for RBAC. FX conversion service caches rates and applies client-specific commissions.
Anything UNCLEAR: The exact FX conversion API provider integration details need specification (which service, authentication method, rate limits, error handling). The notification delivery channels require clarification (email templates, in-app notifications, webhook endpoints). User management integration points with existing auth system need definition including how client_id and user relationships are established.
